wiki.title: Ty Masterson
wiki.extract: Ty Masterson (born September 23, 1969) is an American politician who is the president of the Kansas Senate. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented the 16th district since 2009. From 2005 to 2008, he was a representative in the Kansas House of Representatives. He lives in Andover and has served on the Andover City Council. Masterson is currently running as the Republican nominee for governor of Kansas.
